summary: This is a routine earnings release filed on Form 8-K by Hexcel Corporation on April 22, 2026, reporting its fiscal first quarter results for the period ended March 31, 2026. The filing includes a press release (Exhibit 99.1) and sales data by segment and market (Exhibit 99.2). It contains no special situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or management change. The filing is solely for the purpose of disclosing financial results and does not trigger any risk-arb or special situation analysis.
